title: ASF Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: ASF Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: V4WQ+9J8, Faisal Cantonment, Karachi. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
